_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE sizing policy. Hard caps live in config/protected.json and always win.
sizing_notes: Flat $5. min_edge lowered 0.07->0.04 for the data-collection phase (cycle 1): with zero settled positions, loop count and calibration data are worth more than per-bet EV. Revisit at n>=50 settled.
edge_class_notes: DEEP-2026-07-31: min_edge_book_devig (0.07 = 0.04 base + ~0.03 buffer covering proportional-devig longshot bias (~0.5-1.5c measured on entry odds), scraped-line staleness, and the sharp-counterparty prior on tight books; at n=7 the buffer size is a judgment call) applies to edges derived solely from devigging scraped bookmaker odds against a tight PM book — that class went 0/7 while structural edges went 2/2. Structural edges (information race, cross-market inconsistency) keep min_edge 0.04. max_stake_per_event_usd caps correlated sibling/derivative legs on one underlying event (evidence: CONN@CHI spread+ML -$10, and two open $10 pairs). If book-devig placements drop to ~zero, revisit whether 0.07 should apply only to proportional-devig numbers (power devig already removes the bias). DEEP-2026-08-01: kept 0.07 — the 24h placement drought was candidate supply/researchability, not the threshold (max clean devig edge seen 0.045). min_edge_wide_book (0.30) is the ask-edge floor for the narrow info-race exception to max_spread (playbook §Spread-rule scope): max_spread stays a hard veto for book-devig/benchmark bets; info-race bets held to resolution may exceed it only at ask-edge >= 0.30 with the spread explicitly logged. Evidence: structural wins came from 0.01-0.06-spread books, all 7 book-devig losses from 1c books; b21e42c123a1 (spread 0.13, placed without logging it) is the violation on record that forced the scope decision. DEEP-2026-08-02: 0.07 kept a second day — it blocked zero bets (only clean same-book devig found in ~28 cycles: Pirates/Reds FanDuel, max edge 0.009; every other candidate failed on benchmark reachability, ~20 odds domains returning 403). The 2026-07-31 watch item stays open but is blocked on restoring benchmark access (operator proposal, DEEP-2026-08-02 e.2), not on threshold evidence.
